title: サイレンススズカ、覚醒③

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unprecedented fervor sweeps the Tokyo Racecourse as Grass Wonder, El Condor Pasa, and Silence Suzuka all gather for a single race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle once again joins Reporter Etsuko Otonashi as a spectator.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the crowd eagerly looks on, Silence Suzuka instantly breaks away from the pack, picking up even more speed on the final stretch to claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her unique style of running captivates the hearts of those who witness it.
